nodes.name: Dockerfile
nodes.summary: Single-stage Docker build for the intelipath-service Python component, installing dependencies from requirements.txt and launching the FastAPI app via uvicorn on port 8000.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses python:3.11-slim base image, installs curl for health checks, and runs the app.main:app ASGI entry point with uvicorn.

nodes.name: .dockerignore
nodes.summary: Excludes virtual environments, bytecode caches, environment files, and IDE/agent directories from the Docker build context for intelipath-service.
